MONKIFY

A brand-new multiplayer game — for your fiat and crypto operators

What Monkify is

Not another slot.
A brand-new category.

A real-time, multiplayer betting game: a monkey types characters live, players bet on which sequence appears first, and everyone watches the same round together.

How a round works

Step 01
Pick & stake
A player bets on a sequence of letters or numbers
→
Step 02
Monkey types
Characters stream live — everyone watches the same feed
→
Step 03
First match wins
The first chosen sequence to appear takes the pot
→
Step 04
Paid instantly
Winnings settle on the spot
